name: Hoi An to the Cham Islands
summary: Take the boat from the Cửa Đại pier. Hải Tạng is about 20 km from the Hoi An shore, and the island commune is 18 km from the city. Neither figure is a crossing time.

modes.note: The pier is the Cửa Đại – Cù Lao Chàm inland-waterway berth. A fare, a return clock, and the minutes on the water are Check on arrival. Weather can stop the boats.

seoTitle: Hoi An to the Cham Islands — boat from the Cua Dai pier
seoDescription: The Cửa Đại boat is the way to the Cham Islands. Hải Tạng is about 20 km from the shore and the commune is 18 km out. Time and fare are Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Is the Cham Islands back to Hoi An the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. This page covers both directions. The return is the same water, and the minutes are still Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Does the visit fee include the boat?
faqs.a: No. The visit fee and the boat fare are separate. The boat fare is Check on arrival.
